title: mtORF PCR Protocol
author: Jordan Sims
materials: Gently vortex all PCR reagents. Spin down in mini spinner, if necessary

Add PCR reagents to a 5mL microcentrifuge tube in the following volumes to prepare master mix: 2050µL Taq PCR Master Mix (1025µL x 2) 1722µL molecular grade water (861µL x 2) 82µL 0.1% BSA 82µL 10µM mtORF forward primer 82µL 10µM mtORF reverse primer
Plug in and power on thermal cyclers
Open the miniPCR software. Click the “Devices” tab, highlight the desired thermal cycler, and click “Connect” to connect to the thermal cycler

steps.title: Thaw Samples and Reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw the required samples and PCR reagents on the bench.

substeps.instruction: Remove one aliquot each of Taq PCR Master Mix, molecular grade water, 0.1% BSA, 10µM mtORF forward primer, and 10µM mtORF reverse primer from the freezer.

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Rack
steps.instruction: Transfer fully thawed PCR reagents into an insulated aluminum tube rack removed from the freezer.

steps.title: Prepare and Label PCR Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 sets of PCR strip tubes, labeling each strip with a unique ID and marking the first and last tubes.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the 5mL tube for 2 seconds and aliquot 49µL of master mix into all strip tubes.

steps.title: Add DNA Templates
steps.instruction: Add 1µL of extracted DNA to each PCR strip tube, or 1µL of molecular grade water for negative controls.

substeps.instruction: Pipette onto the side of the strip tube to avoid introducing a bubble.
Verify the correct sample is added to the correct strip tube.

steps.title: Spin and Load Tubes
steps.instruction: Spin the strip tubes down in a mini spinner and place them into the thermal cyclers.

substeps.instruction: Record in the lab notebook which strips are placed into which thermal cycler.

steps.title: Run PCR Protocol
steps.instruction: Initiate the mtORF PCR protocol using the thermal cycler software.

substeps.instruction: Click the 'Library' tab, highlight the mtORF protocol, and select 'Run'.
Choose the appropriate thermal cycler and select 'Upload'.
Verify that the PCR protocol has started running.
Confirm protocol parameters: 94ºC for 60s; 40 cycles of (94ºC for 30s, 53ºC for 30s, and 72ºC for 75s); and 72ºC for 300s.

steps.title: Process Remaining Reactions
steps.instruction: Repeat the loading and running process four more times to start the remaining PCR reactions.

steps.title: Store Amplicons
steps.instruction: Store the resulting PCR amplicons in the fridge.
